title: The whip's wind-up hurts a giant spider with no wait
description: With his back to a giant spider, the player swings the whip: the wind-up behind him takes 1 of its 10 hit points on each of three steps in a row, though its own code waits 10 steps between whip hits, and is still waiting. The spider leaps on him.
